February 21, 1999

Dear Mr. Cowan,

I have a bit of information that you might find useful in the fight.

I am an animal lover. In fact, I have the pleasure of being owned by 5 cats and a very old Sheepdog. Since my wife and I can not have children, they are surrogates, and I love them as much as any parent loves their children.

One of my cats, S., a four year old black female shorthair, (the sweetest little thing) has recently developed epilepsy. This is not an uncommon condition in cats. The disease is usually fatal. Standard treatment is Phenobarbital.The barbiturate poisons the liver because of the high doses needed to control the epilepsy. I could not subject her to the pharmaceutical industry, as you know from our previous emails.

To see her loose control of her rear legs and urinary tract, accompanied by massive salivation and hugely dilated eyes is distressing, to say the least. In desperation, I started dosing her with marijuana; i.e., my exhales.

The results are miraculous.

She quickly calms down, and her eyes constrict back to normal. If she has missed meals because of a prolonged seizure, she insists on eating and drinking. After a short nap she is back to her normal self and playing with the other "kids".
(Marijuananews note: Human epileptics often find cannabis useful, so this is quite plausible. The prohibitionists will probably claim that this is just a plot to legalize hard drugs for puppies and kittens.)

It also seems to help the 16 year old Sheepdog with his arthritis and intake of food and water. Average life span for a Sheepdog is 12 to 14 years of age.

If the "Drug Czar" and DEA are afraid to test Medical Marijuana on humans, there are plenty of sick cats and dogs that would, for a change, love to be test subjects.
(Marijuananews note: The only reason they might go for it is that there is not a lot of money to be made seizing dog houses.

Actually, this is a very worthwhile avenue for experimentation, but the truth will be as threatening to the DEA here as it is in human medicine. This is one area where humans will have to be the guinea pigs for the animals.)

Sincerely Yours,

M.
